name: IntegrationCard
description: An app or service that can be connected to the product: its icon, what it does, whether it is connected, and a switch to connect or disconnect.
whenToUse: On an integrations or apps page, one card per app.
To let people connect a service such as a calendar or chat tool.

whenNotToUse.text: For a single setting inside an account page.

anatomy.name: Icon
anatomy.description: The app’s logo or an icon.

values.meaning: Default. Not connected; the switch is off.
Connected; the card gets a success border.

states.name: Connected
states.meaning: The app is linked and its status shows.

behavior.text: Turning the switch calls onConnectedChange; your handler should start the connection and update the state.
The state is controlled by connected; the card does not change it on its own.

content: Name the app as it is known to people, e.g. "Slack".
Describe what connecting does, e.g. "Post updates to a channel".

guidelines.do: Show the connection state in words and with the switch.
guidelines.why: The state should not depend on reading the switch position alone.

guidelines.do: Explain what connecting gives access to.
guidelines.dont: Connect without saying what data is shared.
guidelines.why: People should know what they are allowing before they switch it on.

guidelines.do: Put disconnect and configure options in the footer.
guidelines.dont: Hide the disconnect option behind a menu only.
guidelines.why: Leaving an integration should be as easy as joining it.

accessibility.role: article, named by the app name; the switch is named "Connect {name}".

keyboard.action: Moves to the switch and then the actions.
Turns the switch on or off.

accessibility.focus: The switch and actions show their own focus rings.

wcag.how: Status is written out as text, not only shown by colour.
The switch states its name and on/off value.

notes: The app icon is decorative; the name carries the meaning.

examples.title: Connected app
examples.description: A connected app with a configure action.

examples.title: Available app
examples.description: An app that is not connected yet.
examples.code:
import { IntegrationCard } from '@ds/react';

<IntegrationCard name="Google Calendar" description="Show meetings on your planner." icon={<CalendarIcon />} connected={false} onConnectedChange={connect} />

examples.title: In a grid
examples.description: Cards side by side, each with its own switch.

related.relation: For on/off settings inside an account page.

components.name: IntegrationCard
components.description:
An app or service that can be connected to the product: its icon, what it does, whether it is
connected, and a switch to connect or disconnect.

description.description: What connecting it does, in a sentence.

icon.description: The app's logo or an icon.

onConnectedChange.description: Called when the switch is turned on or off.

actions.description: Further actions in the footer, e.g. "Configure".

--integration-card-connected-border-colo.description: Regular tone outline, e.g. alert borders.
